title.rendered: The Lord Is My Shepherd, I Lack Nothing: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Not I lack less. Not I have enough to get by. I lack nothing. The Lord is my shepherd, personal, attentive, present, and in His care, the cup doesn’t just fill. It overflows.

content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Saturday, May 9, 2026

📖 Today’s Scripture

“The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.”
Psalm 23:1 (NIV) | ESV

📝 Today’s Message

David does not say the Lord is a shepherd, he says the Lord is my shepherd. Personal. Present. Mine. And the immediate consequence of that personal possession is total sufficiency: I lack nothing.

Not I lack less. Not I have enough to get by. I lack nothing. Because the shepherd I have is not a limited shepherd managing scarce resources across too many sheep. He is the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth, the One who owns the cattle on a thousand hills, the One whose supply has no ceiling and whose care has no limit.

Psalm 23 unfolds what “I lack nothing” looks like in practice: green pastures, quiet waters, restored soul, right paths, presence in the darkest valley, a table prepared in the presence of enemies, anointing oil, an overflowing cup. This is not the life of someone barely getting by. The cup does not fill to the brim, it overflows.

As we close this week, from righteousness to abiding in the vine, today’s psalm brings it to its simplest, most personal expression. The Lord is your shepherd. You are not navigating life alone. You have a Shepherd who leads, restores, protects, provides, and pursues you with goodness and mercy every single day. In His care, you lack nothing.

🙏 Prayer

Father, You are my shepherd, my personal, attentive, present shepherd. Because You lead me I lack nothing. I trust You today with every area of my life that feels scarce or uncertain. You restore my soul, You guide my paths, You prepare a table for me. I follow You with confidence. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

🗣️ Declaration

The Lord is my shepherd and I lack nothing. Every need is met, every path is guided, every valley is walked through with His presence. I am not managing life alone, I have the Lord as my shepherd. I live from the overflow of His provision, His restoration and His goodness. Surely goodness and mercy follow me all the days of my life.
